landing.metaTitle: Comeby: free, beautiful invites for every hangout
landing.heroTitle: Invite anyone in seconds. Know exactly who's coming.
landing.heroSubtitle: Make a beautiful invite for your birthday, picnic, hike or game night, share one link in WhatsApp, and watch the replies roll in. Guests just tap and type their name. No app, no account.
landing.stepsTitle: From plan to headcount in a minute
landing.step1Body: Pick a theme, add the when and where. Done in under a minute.
landing.step2Body: Send it to your WhatsApp group, or anywhere else. It looks great when shared.
landing.step3Body: See who's going, who's not and what they said, live, with a timestamp on every reply.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a host needs. Nothing a guest has to do.
landing.featureGuestsBody: No app, no account. They open the link, tap Going and they're in.
landing.featureTrackingBody: Live counts including +1s, every message, every change, exportable any time.
landing.featureUpdatesBody: Change the time or place and guests get notified, plus a ready-made message for your group.
landing.featurePrivacyBody: Only people with the link can see your event. Phone numbers stay with you.
landing.themesTitle: Five looks for every kind of plan
landing.openSourceBody: Comeby has no ads, doesn't sell data and doesn't hide basics behind a paywall. The code is public, so anyone can check what it does.
landing.finalCtaBody: Your next hangout is one link away.

privacySections.title: The short version
privacySections.body: Comeby is free and has no ads. We collect only what is needed to run invites, we never sell data, and guests' contact details are deleted automatically after events. The code is open source, so anyone can check this.

privacySections.title: What hosts give us
privacySections.body: To create an account you give us your name, email and a password (stored as a secure hash), or you sign in with Google. You create events with details you choose, such as a title, time, place and an optional cover image.

privacySections.title: What guests give us
privacySections.body: Guests don't need an account. When you respond to an invite you give your name and, if the host asks, your phone number. A message, answers to the host's questions and an email for updates are optional. Your phone number, email and message are only visible to the host. Other guests only see names if the host chose to show who's going.

privacySections.title: How we use it
privacySections.body: Only to run Comeby: showing invites, collecting responses, notifying hosts, emailing guests who asked for updates, preventing spam and abuse, and keeping the service secure. We never use your data for advertising and never sell or share it with advertisers.

privacySections.title: How long we keep it
privacySections.body: Guests' phone numbers and emails are deleted automatically 90 days after an event ends. Hosts can delete events, responses or their whole account at any time, which deletes the related data. Backups are overwritten within 30 days.

privacySections.title: Cookies
privacySections.body: We use a few essential cookies: one to keep hosts signed in, one per invite so your browser remembers your own response, and one random ID used only to stop spam. No advertising or tracking cookies. If analytics is enabled it is privacy-friendly and cookie-less.

privacySections.title: Who processes data for us
privacySections.body: Comeby runs on servers we control. We use an email provider to send emails, Cloudflare for security and to store cover images, and optionally Cloudflare Turnstile to block bots. They only process data to provide these services.

privacySections.title: Your rights
privacySections.body: You can see, correct, export or delete your data. Hosts can do most of this from Settings and the event dashboard. Guests can change their response using the private link in their confirmation email, or ask the host. For anything else, contact us and we'll help.

privacySections.title: Children
privacySections.body: Comeby is for people aged 13 and over (16 and over where local law requires it).

privacySections.title: Changes
privacySections.body: If we change this policy we will update the date above and, for important changes, tell hosts by email.

termsSections.title: Using Comeby
termsSections.body: Comeby lets hosts create invitations and collect responses. It is free. By using it you agree to these terms. You must be at least 13 (or 16 where local law requires it).

termsSections.title: Your content
termsSections.body: You are responsible for the events you create and the information you share. You keep ownership of your content and give us permission to store and display it only so Comeby can work.

termsSections.title: Not allowed
termsSections.body: Do not use Comeby for spam, scams, phishing, harassment, illegal activity, or to collect people's data under false pretences. Do not try to break, overload or get around Comeby's limits and security. We may remove events or accounts that break these rules, and reported events may be hidden while we review them.

termsSections.title: Free-tier limits
termsSections.body: To keep Comeby free for everyone there are limits, for example on the number of upcoming events, events per month and responses per event. Limits may change over time.

termsSections.title: No guarantees
termsSections.body: We work hard to keep Comeby reliable, but it is provided as is, without warranties. We are not responsible for events themselves, what happens at them, or losses caused by downtime or mistakes, to the extent the law allows.

termsSections.title: Open source
termsSections.body: Comeby's source code is available under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. These terms cover the hosted service at comeby.org.

termsSections.title: Changes and ending
termsSections.body: We may update these terms and will update the date above when we do. You can stop using Comeby and delete your account at any time.
